verdict.rationale: Puzzle has an API, positioned for embedded accounting and 'originally architected for deep platform-to-platform integrations,' which suggests it is aimed at partner integrations rather than broad end-user parity. It also has an MCP integration that gives Claude conversational access to financial data, but nothing shows UI-equivalent write coverage. No public OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: any documented API endpoint reference or coverage list, evidence of API parity with UI features (invoicing, reconciliation, categorization rules, journal entries, AI Close), evidence that the API is available to ordinary users rather than only platforms, write operations via MCP, and independent corroboration.
